title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：search　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 search 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the grandmother ① made the search that no child in the courtyard would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② search, meaning the hunt itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a search, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ search in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ search at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A search, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grandmother said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the search was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the hunt. The ⑥ search, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; search, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a hunt and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ search had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ search of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of recording; search, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ search I remember is the hunt recorded in the diary, which closed in 1967 and is still recorded as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ search, my mother said in 1969, is the only hunt that improves by being recorded; every search, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a hunt. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 搜寻；搜查（指院子里每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 搜寻；搜查（指那次搜寻本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the search 展开这一次搜寻
D. n. 搜寻；搜查（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 搜寻之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的搜寻之事）
F. n. 搜寻；搜查（指日记里写到、被记载的那一次）
G. n. 搜寻、指望（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 指望（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the search that no child in the courtyard would have recorded
The search, meaning the hunt itself and not the lamp
the search at the far window
the search was the whole of the matter
the search had become a line in a diary
The search of the whole thing
A search, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: make the search 意为“展开这一次搜寻”，1960 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记载的一次搜寻做了一遍。
search 意为“搜寻；搜查”，指那次搜寻本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
search 意为“搜寻；搜查”，指院子里每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
search 意为“搜寻；搜查”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
search 意为“搜寻、指望”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次指望就是那件事的全部。
search 意为“指望”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那次搜寻，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
search 意为“搜寻；搜查”，指日记里写到、被记载的那一次，到 1965 年这一次成了日记里的一行。
search 意为“搜寻之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的搜寻之事是一处院子和三个年头的记载。
search 意为“搜寻；搜查”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一次，1967 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一次。
search 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，搜寻是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的搜寻。
